method: Isolated Go service and headless Chromium with synthetic workbooks. Each receipt identifies its own run and assets.

checks: calculator removes the redundant compat blurb
status-bar zoom percentage button resets zoom to 100%
external and cross-sheet internal hyperlinks switch to visited color in both light and dark reading themes and retain visited state across sheet round-trips
classic top-right font picker opens a unified base-select themed popover with active highlight on selection
dialog select, file input and disclosure controls render with unified theme tokens
Classic is the default; desktop, narrow and breakpoint widths preserve one top row, working font and search controls, hit targets and formula space
Icon hit targets, hover names, native font selection and separate formula/value clipboard commands work
Header context menu and tray callbacks both switch the same persisted preference; control identity, command search and workbook binding survive the switch without new source jobs
A tray layout change keeps an in-progress edit and the active formula field
Clear all caches returns both tabs to home, empties disk cache, preserves source bytes, and reopens the workbook with its leading-zero ID
Eight widths and four pixel ratios: core commands, tabs, command search, workbook name and formula controls fit and receive pointer input without new source tasks
At 760 px 3 commands fold into the overflow menu and still run
The 320 px overflow font picker updates the grid and retains the selection; an idle ribbon keeps its overflow state stable over 12 frames
Resizing the bar itself, independent of the window, recomputes overflow
Each of the five tabs shows exactly its own panel
Every tab command is registered in command search; eight open their dialogs; a command on another tab brings its tab forward and anchors its menu to the button
A column menu opened from command search while folded is anchored to its visible button; Escape closes it and restores focus
Ctrl+F1 folds the bar, a tab opens it over the sheet for one command, and the choice is remembered
Compact worksheet tabs page through 80 sheets, with a theme-aware divider between adjacent names
Keyboard browsing beyond the first sixty entries selects and opens the eightieth worksheet

no explanation reads while loading/selecting; explicit toolbar and F2 preserve exact source numbers, native text/identifiers, formula cached/missing/unavailable/error/empty-string states and sparse outside-used blank
actual successful filter and sort appear in details; 420px light/dark layouts fit without horizontal overflow and resizing performs no source/explanation requests

actual failed request retries successfully; native Escape cancels a held read, immediate reopen rejects its late numeric reply; equal-content different-path upload closes old details and rejects stale responses
real CSV imported accounting amount and leading-zero identifier, and real CFB/BIFF8 numeric source use the same detail controller and exact qualification

real source controls and system clipboard support TSV with literal HTML text, escaped Markdown and versioned JSON; hidden duplicate headers, huge decimals, leading-zero IDs, formulas and source rows/types survive without writing the source

missing caches refuse value copying, unavailable shared expressions refuse formula copying while JSON retains their true state; cancelled delayed source responses cannot overwrite a newer copy preview
real sort and row-hide controls copy only the visible visual order, while an explicitly requested hidden source header remains separate

preview performs no writes; transposition/skip-empty/header removal save in exactly one atomic batch and undo/redo together; structured JSON pastes exact raw strings, identifiers and multiline text into the independent analysis table
formula-mode structured paste stores the exact formula as literal text, then undoes to its previous cached value; the readonly source remains unchanged

JSON numeric primitives are refused; stale revision saves preserve the newer page and retain the complete paste input until explicit target reload; a failed save leaves durable source data intact and the draft can be explicitly retried
real main and frozen grids share numeric width markers; double-click auto-fit reads the complete source display and restores the exact amount without changing raw source/type

seven served asset hashes match current source; opening/indexing perform no print IO; narrow numeric cells use width markers with exact raw/formatted value retained, leading-zero text/rich spans/missing formula cache/hidden exclusion/covered-corner merge perimeter survive; source header definitions remain safe text; screen zoom causes no data/index query
actual page navigation reaches a later 3000pt-row slice with full source dimensions and negative physical offset, preserving repeated title and real source page numbers
desktop, 420px and dark layouts keep footer/page controls accessible and paper inside fit viewport; paper and source fills retain original colors

explicit custom paper/margins/range/fit apply together; failed first-page refresh preserves the accepted paper; cancellation followed by immediate retry cleans a deliberately delayed start without replacing the newer preview

same-content uploads retain distinct path identity; empty source has no invented A1 page, a hidden merged anchor does not move its text, native BIFF8 uses the same preview and CSV respects the shared capability registry
